mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fields ( id, space_id, event_id, form_id, kind, system_key, label, position, answer_type, required, description, config, show_when, hidden, preset_key, preset_state) VALUES ( #{id}, #{spaceId}, #{eventId}, #{formId}, #{kind}, #{systemKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{label}, #{position}, #{answerType}, #{required}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST(#{config} AS jsonb), CAST(#{showWhen,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{hidden}, #{presetKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST(#{presetState,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb))
